name: bfl-flux
description: Black Forest Labs FLUX — open-weight text-to-image, image editing, inpainting/outpainting, structural conditioning, and image variation models. Includes FLUX.1 [schnell] (Apache-2.0), FLUX.1 [dev], Kontext, Fill, Canny, Depth, Redux, and Krea variants. PyTorch inference library with CLI, Gradio/Streamlit demos, diffusers integration, and optional TensorRT acceleration.
license: Apache-2.0 (schnell model); FLUX.1-dev Non-Commercial License (all other models)
author: Black Forest Labs

security_review.notes: subprocess.run(shell=True) in src/flux/trt/trt_config/base_trt_config.py:167 runs 'polygraphy convert {onnx_path}' — TRT engine builder using developer-controlled file paths, not user input. No eval(), no pickle.loads from remote, no obfuscated code, no curl|sh patterns. PyTorch .eval() is model evaluation mode, not code execution.
